modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a four-source comparison table: spec, in-band SDR/list and OOB SDR/list, keyed by stable sensor number/ID and physical slot.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sensor naming and formatting vary across BMC/ipmitool versions; readings may change normally, so comparison needs units, timestamps and ranges rather than string equality.
